title: Bullseye Builds: Target Invests in Community
summary: Bullseye Builds with Community Program is Target’s signature community activation, bringing together Target’s volunteerism and design expertise to meet local needs.
body_markdown:
Bullseye Builds with Community Program is Target’s signature community activation, bringing together Target’s volunteerism and design expertise to meet local needs.


As part of a previously announced[$1 million investment](https://corporate.target.com/press/release/2026/02/target-celebrates-10th-year-of-1-million-volunteer-hours,-deepens-community-vitalization-efforts-for) , we will complete 13 Bullseye Builds projects nationwide in 2026 to bring vibrancy to community spaces based on locally identified priorities. These investments focus on strengthening the everyday places that make neighborhoods more connected, functional and welcoming — powered by Target team members who show up locally through hands-on volunteer efforts.


Team Target can be found volunteering in our communities all across the country nearly every day of the year.
